behavior.note: an element selector of yours loses to every rule of the library; before 0.23 it could win over the rules that the library wrote inside :where()
a rest class of yours that comes before the library's stylesheet wins over the library's rest rules and over the disabled look of Button, as one that comes after it already did
a class of yours that names a state wins over the library's rule for that state, also when it comes before the library's stylesheet
a rule of yours on an element state (a:hover, :focus) no longer changes the hover of the library's links, nor the focus ring of its links, navbar links and breadcrumbs
